tldr: Saturn in the 7th house: you must build, mature, and face limits in partnership and one-to-one bonds
body: Saturn in the 7th house: you must build, mature, and face limits in partnership and one-to-one bonds. Gift: lasting mastery there. Watch: fear and heaviness. With Saturn in the 7th house, structure, limits, discipline, time, responsibility, fear, mastery, and earned authority move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable. Left unconscious, it can become fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed.
gift: commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
